name: Ore to Kanojo ga Mystery na Ken ni Tsuite
original_name: 俺と彼女がミステリーな件について
source:
This is the debut work for P.W., a sister brand to I.D.. 

Ayumu is able to see and hear things that other people can’t. He used to be bothered by it as a child, but now he has become used to it. When his father got a long-term overseas appointment, they sold the house expecting that he would naturally come along with them. However, Ayumu told them that he would rather stay in Japan. They relented only when they found him a place at his aunt’s apartment in the countryside where he had lived as a child.

Ayumu reunited with his cousin Touka and joined her mystery circle club at his new school. Every one of its members are quite interested in various mystery elements, from black magic to UFOs. The warmth and enjoyment that he felt in the club made him at ease and soon it became an irreplaceable thing to him.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/07/19/july-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是I.D.的姊妹品牌P.W.的首次亮相。

Ayumu能够看到和听到其他人看不到和听到的东西。小时候他曾为此烦恼过，但现在他已经习惯了。当他的父亲得到长期的海外任命时，他们卖掉了房子，希望他自然会跟他们一起去。然而，步告诉他们他宁愿留在日本。当他们在他小时候住过的乡下姨妈的公寓里为他找到一个住处时，他们才态度软化。

步与表弟藤花重聚，并在新学校加入了她的神秘圈俱乐部。它的每一位成员都对各种神秘元素非常感兴趣，从黑魔法到不明飞行物。在俱乐部里感受到的温暖和享受让他感到安心，很快这对他来说就成为了一种不可替代的东西。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/07/19/july-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
